title: SN Sexual Memories
tagline: Every OStim or SexLab scene becomes a memory for everyone who took part, and for a bystander who saw it.
description: Prompts for SN Sexual Memories (SN_SexualHistory.dll). When an OStim or SexLab scene ends, SN_SexualHistory.dll gathers who took part, the place, the animations played, who climaxed, the SkyrimNet events recorded during the scene and each participant's relevant memories, and sends them with the sn_sexual_history_memory prompt once for every participant, the player included. The answer is stored as that participant's memory. When the MCM's diary option is on, the sn_sexual_history_diary prompt then writes a diary entry for every participant, stored as their SkyrimNet diary entry. When a bystander saw the scene, the sn_sexual_history_witness prompt writes that bystander's memory of what they saw. When the MCM option is on, the sn_sexual_history_player_talk prompt writes a line the player says to an NPC nearby.
author: nightlantern-mods
